Question: FinOps Practitioner / Analyst (finops framework and personas)
Answer: day-to-day operator of the practice. Builds reports, runs allocation, drives optimization recommendations. Primary audience for FOCA.

Question: Engineering / DevOps / SRE (finops framework and personas)
Answer: owns architecture, rightsizing, and implementation of optimization.

Question: Finance (finops framework and personas)
Answer: owns budgeting, invoicing, accounting treatment of cloud (OpEx, COGS, capex for commitments).

Question: Procurement (finops framework and personas)
Answer: owns contracts, EDPs, MACC, private pricing.

Question: Leadership (finops framework and personas)
Answer: sponsors the practice, sets KPIs, removes blockers.

Question: Product (finops framework and personas)
Answer: defines the business metrics that anchor unit economics.

Question: ITAM / Software Asset Management (finops framework and personas)
Answer: licensing, BYOL, SaaS spend governance.

Question: Sustainability (finops framework and personas)
Answer: emissions and GreenOps alignment.

Question: Direct (cost allocation and tagging)
Answer: bill it to the service that generated it (when identifiable)

Question: Proportional (cost allocation and tagging)
Answer: split by direct spend share

Question: Even (cost allocation and tagging)
Answer: split equally across business units

Question: Fixed (cost allocation and tagging)
Answer: pre-negotiated percentages

Question: Usage-based (cost allocation and tagging)
Answer: by a driver metric (requests, GB, cores)

Question: Allocation coverage (cost allocation and tagging)
Answer: percent of spend mapped to a business owner

Question: Tag coverage (cost allocation and tagging)
Answer: percent of resources with all mandatory tags

Question: Unallocated trend (cost allocation and tagging)
Answer: absolute and relative over time

Question: Allocation dispute rate (cost allocation and tagging)
Answer: invoices disputed per month

Question: Anomaly (anomaly detection and reporting)
Answer: a statistically unusual deviation from expected cost or usage

Question: Variance (anomaly detection and reporting)
Answer: a difference between plan (budget, forecast) and actual, not necessarily unusual

Question: Drift (anomaly detection and reporting)
Answer: a slow, cumulative change that would not trigger a daily anomaly but shifts the baseline

Question: Incident (anomaly detection and reporting)
Answer: an anomaly that warranted action (not every anomaly is an incident)

Question: Z-score (anomaly detection and reporting)
Answer: standard deviations from mean; assumes normality

Question: MAD (median absolute deviation) (anomaly detection and reporting)
Answer: robust to outliers and skew, preferred for spiky spend

Question: Seasonal decomposition (anomaly detection and reporting)
Answer: separates trend, seasonality, residual; alert on residual

Question: Period variance (anomaly detection and reporting)
Answer: this month vs last month, this week vs same week last year

Question: Plan variance (anomaly detection and reporting)
Answer: actual vs budget or forecast

Question: Run-rate variance (anomaly detection and reporting)
Answer: annualized current burn vs target

Question: Showback (chargeback showback models)
Answer: visibility of costs to business units without an actual financial transfer. Teams see what they spend; budgets and P&L do not move on that basis.

Question: Chargeback (chargeback showback models)
Answer: actual internal financial transfer. Business unit budget is debited, IT / platform budget is credited.

Question: Hybrid (chargeback showback models)
Answer: showback for most cost, chargeback for a subset (for example, only production prod cost is charged back, dev is showback).

Question: Pass-through (chargeback showback models)
Answer: exact cost, dollar for dollar

Question: Pass-through plus overhead (chargeback showback models)
Answer: cost plus a markup for platform and FinOps labor

Question: Fixed-rate (chargeback showback models)
Answer: pre-negotiated unit rates (for example, dollars per CPU-hour for a shared platform)

Question: Blended (chargeback showback models)
Answer: an averaged rate across a portfolio

Question: Allocation coverage (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: allocated cost / total cost

Question: Tag coverage (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: tagged resources / total resources

Question: Unallocated dollars trend (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: absolute unallocated per month

Question: Commitment coverage (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: eligible usage covered by commits / total eligible usage

Question: Commitment utilization (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: commitment hours used / commitment hours purchased

Question: Effective Savings Rate (ESR) (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: (ListCost - EffectiveCost) / ListCost

Question: Idle resource percent (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: idle cost / total cost

Question: Storage efficiency (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: GB used / GB billed, or hot vs cold tier mix

Question: Forecast accuracy (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: 1 - abs(actual - forecast) / actual

Question: Plan variance (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: (actual - plan) / plan

Question: Budget burn rate (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: cumulative spend / days elapsed, annualized

Question: MTTD for anomalies (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: MTTR for anomalies

Question: Allocation dispute rate (unit economics and kpis)
Answer: FinOps education reach: percent of engineers trained
